decision_record.calculation: Fixture (ticket $400): fire 8.00, current close 12.00 (> cap 10): control enters qty 50 AND sells the QQQ reserve leg; treatment enters 0 and sells nothing. Current close 9.00: control qty 50, treatment qty 44 sized off the executable close.
decision_record.comparison: Pre-change engine vs the sleeve's own design gates: gates and sizing used the signal-time fire price, while the market order fills at the current price. Reserve mode executes >=1 session after the fire BY DESIGN, so the fire price is guaranteed stale at execution.
decision_record.experiment: Fixture A/B on identical fires/bars (TestG4ReserveReprice): treatment (switch ON) vs control (switch OFF = pre-change fire-price rule), paired shadow record on the entry intent's enhance_exp; no-current-bar case preserves the legacy path.
decision_record.mechanism: Execution/pricing leak (owner priority #1 class): stale fire price. Above-cap drift bought a name the design refuses; within-cap drift overshot ticket notional at fill (unpriced risk); a fall under-deployed the ticket. The QQQ reserve leg was also sold to fund an entry whose executable terms were never revalidated.
decision_record.transfer: Tensor G4 edge is paid by buying the fired cohort inside the design price cap (<=10) at the designed ticket; the payer is the momentum cohort's continuation, captured only if the executed position matches the design's price/risk terms.
